summary: Shows the klist output when delegation fails, and explains the target resource must have an SPN in AD and be accessed by hostname, not IP or alias.
questions: Why does my file share access fail even with Kerberos delegation?
Do I need to use FQDNs for file shares with Kerberos?
What does failed Kerberos delegation look like in klist?

answer_card.title: When delegation fails
answer_card.answer_md:
Failed delegation shows `Server: http/winhost.my.domain.com` and no `forwarded` flag.

The target resource also needs a registered **SPN** in AD and must be accessed by **hostname**, not IP or alias. Use `\\server.fqdn.com\share`, not `\\192.168.1.2\share`.
